note: DOIT DevKit V1 is a third-party clone board (not an official Espressif reference board) but is the de-facto standard '30-pin ESP32 DevKit V1' referenced everywhere. Board-level dimensions/positions vary slightly by manufacturer batch -- marked 'estimated' below where sources disagreed. Chip-level facts (WROOM-32 module spec, crystal freq, GPIO numbering) come from Espressif's own ESP32-WROOM-32 datasheet and are marked 'confirmed'.

pcb_board.note: estimated -- mischianti.org measured SVG says 51.8x28.2mm, espboards.dev says 51.45x23.37mm; used the wider figure as it matches standard 2x15 0.1in header spacing better

esp32_chip.note: WROOM-32 module footprint is a well-documented Espressif spec (18x25.5x3.1mm); position centered on DevKit board is estimated

crystal_oscillator.note: 40MHz crystal is the Espressif-specified reference for ESP32; it is inside the WROOM-32 module can, not a separate visible board component -- shown separately here for visualization clarity only

ams1117_regulator.note: estimated -- AMS1117-3.3 is the near-universal LDO on this clone board family (widely documented across community teardowns), but exact part markings vary by manufacturer batch

usb_connector.note: Micro-USB (not USB-C) is standard on this board family; position at one short edge is standard across all sources

wifi_antenna.type: PCB trace (meandering/serpentine), integrated in WROOM-32 module
wifi_antenna.note: ESP32-WROOM-32 uses an on-module PCB trace antenna at the module's top edge (Espressif datasheet); exact trace geometry is proprietary, shown here as a representative serpentine pattern

gpio_header_left.note: standard DOIT DevKit V1 30-pin silkscreen order, cross-referenced across multiple pinout sites

gpio_header_right.note: standard DOIT DevKit V1 30-pin silkscreen order, cross-referenced across multiple pinout sites

boot_button.label: BOOT (IO0)
boot_button.note: estimated position near USB end; function (pulls GPIO0 low to enter flash mode) is confirmed

enable_button.label: EN (reset)
enable_button.note: estimated position near USB end; function (chip reset) is confirmed

power_led.label: PWR (red)
power_led.note: position estimated; presence of a power-on LED is standard across this board family

user_led.label: GPIO2 onboard LED (blue, varies by batch)
user_led.note: GPIO2 onboard LED is a well-documented standard feature of this board family

decoupling_caps.note: estimated -- generic decoupling near regulator output and chip VDD pins, standard practice, exact placement not published

chip_electrical.note: current/voltage/temp limits from Espressif ESP32 series datasheet; thermal resistance and the two 'typical_*' baseline currents are engineering-estimate defaults (unloaded pins/peripherals draw a small but non-zero current) used only when a query doesn't specify them, not separately published for WROOM-32
